scripts.name: rke2-node
scripts.contents:
K8S_MODE="$k8s_mode"
K8S_SERVER="$k8s_server"
K8S_TOKEN="$k8s_token"
K8S_CHANNEL="$k8s_channel"
#raw
systemctl disable firewalld.service nm-cloud-setup.service nm-cloud-setup.timer 2>/dev/null || true
mkdir -p /etc/rancher/rke2
if [ "$K8S_MODE" = new ]; then
  ROLE=server
  printf 'token: %s\n' "$K8S_TOKEN" > /etc/rancher/rke2/config.yaml
else
  ROLE=agent
  printf 'server: https://%s:9345\ntoken: %s\n' "$K8S_SERVER" "$K8S_TOKEN" > /etc/rancher/rke2/config.yaml
fi
curl -sfL https://get.rke2.io | INSTALL_RKE2_TYPE="$ROLE" INSTALL_RKE2_CHANNEL="$K8S_CHANNEL" sh -
systemctl enable "rke2-$ROLE.service"
#end raw

post.name: lab-firstboot
post.content:
#!/bin/bash
mkdir -p /usr/local/sbin
cat > /usr/local/sbin/lab-firstboot.sh <<'FIRSTBOOT'
#!/bin/bash
# One-shot first boot: register with SMLM, then join the jovian RKE2 cluster as an agent.
set -e
curl -sSfk https://sol.mydemo.lab/pub/bootstrap/1-leap16.sh | bash
mkdir -p /etc/rancher/rke2
printf 'server: https://amalthea.mydemo.lab:9345
token: %s
' 'jovian-7a3749624410b0ecd817f07c4a183156' > /etc/rancher/rke2/config.yaml
curl -sfL https://get.rke2.io | INSTALL_RKE2_TYPE=agent INSTALL_RKE2_VERSION=v1.36.5+rke2r1 sh -
systemctl enable --now rke2-agent.service
systemctl disable lab-firstboot.service
FIRSTBOOT
chmod 0700 /usr/local/sbin/lab-firstboot.sh
cat > /etc/systemd/system/lab-firstboot.service <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Lab first boot: SMLM registration and RKE2 join
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/lab-firstboot.sh
RemainAfterExit=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNIT
systemctl enable lab-firstboot.service
